reason: The goal explicitly calls for fitting the arming plug, and the flight console is the available place to use it.
expectation: The plug will arm the flight console and enable launch.

effect: The plug armed the console and initiated launch in the same action, completing the chapter.
reaction: The separation of the lower stage and the shrinking view of the station made the launch feel like a fitting conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the arming plug was worthwhile because it gave the astronaut the final command and brought the departure into view.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was no particularly confusing or repetitive passage in this one-action chapter, though the decision itself was straightforward.

surprise.text: I expected the plug to enable launch; it also led directly to pressing START and lifting off in the same result.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: the plug and console were explicitly connected to the launch goal.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see what the receiving laboratories discover in the cores; the launch provides closure while leaving that question open.
